craft_notes: Sthāyin: the seal (kaṇṭhe lagnā — neck-clasped; no more teaching: the tantra ends on a body). Sanskrit: jñātvā...kathitaṃ...mudita...kaṇṭhe lagnā → L4 keeps known-spoken-delighted then the clasp. Rows: row 3 (delighted→clung). Close: clung (lagna — stuck-fast, paper-thin finale: body, not doctrine). Rejected: 'embraced' — killed: clung kept (the seal is physical); closing on doctrine-summary — killed: the tantra ends on a neck (that IS the doctrine). Read aloud: known-today / spoken-delighted / goddess-on-neck / to-Śiva's-CLUNG.

lines: Heart of all power-divisions known today:
spoken, delighted — goddess on neck, to Śiva's clung.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvaśaktiprabhedānāṃ hṛdayaṃ jñātam adya ca | ity uktvānanditā devi ka.ṅthe lagnā śivasya tu
